body:
🌍 Level Border Challenge
Welcome to the Level Border Challenge! A professional and highly customizable challenge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1.

In this mod, your world is restricted by a World Border that starts tiny (e.g., 1x1). The only way to expand your territory? Gain experience! For every level you climb, the border expands, giving you more space to explore, mine, and survive.

🚀 Features
XP-Based Growth: The border size is tied to your experience level. Level up to survive!

Custom Spawn Logic: Start every challenge by being teleported to the world spawn, where a tree is automatically generated for you to stand on. No more dying in a 1x1 hole!

Interactive GUI: A full-blown configuration menu with a sleek gray-glass design.

Real-time Config: Change settings on the fly without restarting your world.

🛠 Commands
/challenge start – Initializes the challenge, shrinks the border, builds the spawn tree, and teleports you.

NEW: /challenge configurations – Opens the interactive GUI to customize your experience.

/challenge stop – Pauses the border growth logic.

/challenge reset – Resets the World Border to the vanilla maximum.

⚙️ Configuration
You can adjust the following settings directly in the game menu:

Start Size: How big the border is at Level 0.

Blocks per Level: How many blocks the border grows for each XP level.

Border Damage: Toggle whether being outside the border should hurt you.

📦 Installation
Make sure you are on Fabric 1.20.1.

Install the Fabric API (required).

Drop the mod jar into your mods folder.

Start the game and use /challenge start to begin!
